entries.title: Wildfire now nine miles from French city of Bordeaux, mayor warns
entries.snippet: Thomas Cazenave says they are preparing if further evacuations are issued, as the mayor of a nearby town called the situation "catastrophic".

entries.title: Trump says Iran war talks taking place during lull in strikes
entries.snippet: The US president says "there is a good chance that something could happen", as Iran denies direct talks are taking place.

entries.title: Ukraine dismisses Iranian threats as Caspian Sea strike directly links wars
entries.snippet: Iran has reacted with fury to the assault on the vessel, with Tehran's foreign minister saying it "cannot go unanswered".

entries.title: China's new challenge as natural disasters strike - fake AI videos
entries.snippet: Storms and flooding incidents over the last few months have seen fake videos inundating social media.

entries.title: A Japanese town wrestles with identity after protests over its first mosque
entries.snippet: As Japan increasingly relies on foreign workers, it is also grappling with how to integrate new cultures and religions.

entries.title: Anger as Berlin Pride attacker revealed to have been freed weeks earlier
entries.snippet: As details emerge about the suspected Berlin Pride attacker's past, many are asking why he was not in prison.

entries.title: US singer D4vd to go on trial for murder in death of 14-year-old
entries.snippet: The star is accused of killing Celeste Rivas Hernandez, whose remains were found in a Tesla registered to his address.

entries.title: Wildfire witnesses describe 'wall of flames', fear and stress
entries.snippet: Local and visitors tell the BBC of disbelief and anxiety as wildfires force more than 300,000 people to evacuate.

entries.title: Shots fired at US consulate in Toronto for a second time this year
entries.snippet: Police said they engaged in a high-speed car chase but failed to arrest the suspect, who remains at large. Three people were arrested in June after a similar attack.

entries.title: Chile captures fugitive convicted of singer Victor Jara's murder under Pinochet
entries.snippet: Nelson Haase was one of those convicted over the kidnap and murder of folk singer Victor Jara after Chile's military coup in 1973.

entries.title: Carly Simon reveals Parkinson's diagnosis
entries.snippet: The singer also reveals she has received treatment for skin cancer, but vows to keep singing.

entries.title: 'Do the right thing': Savannah Guthrie makes another plea to mother's kidnappers
entries.snippet: The US journalist has made several social media pleas for the abductors of her mother Nancy to share where she is.

entries.title: Number of suspects in fatal Seattle food festival shooting rises to three
entries.snippet: One suspect is in custody, while a second is being sought and a third is thought to have died at the scene, court documents show.

entries.title: Bali bans Dutch expats whose run club allegedly excluded Indonesians
entries.snippet: The two men, who are accused of favouring foreigners for their events, allegedly violated immigration laws.

entries.title: South Africa investigates death of Nigerian who collapsed during arrest
entries.snippet: Initial reports from a post-mortem said he had "abrasions on his back and chest", investigators say.

entries.title: More than 600 US military service members injured since Iran War began in February
entries.snippet: The latest figure includes casualties from Operation Fury and a new category called "Overseas Operations".

entries.title: Oil price dives as US and Iran pause attacks
entries.snippet: The US says attacks on Iran have been halted to give "talks some space", raising hopes of a resolution to the conflict.

entries.title: 'Dr Death', Body Worlds creator Gunther von Hagens, dies at 81
entries.snippet: The family of the anatomist vowed to carry out his wish for his body to be preserved using the plastination technique he developed himself.

entries.title: As the US pauses the war with Iran, is Trump really running out of weapons?
entries.snippet: The US has fired thousands of hard-to-replace missiles during its war with Iran. We unpack whether its "arsenal of freedom" is perilously low.

entries.title: Devastating European wildfires in maps - and how they're being tackled
entries.snippet: A blaze near Bordeaux has torn through more than 162 sq miles (420 sq km) in less than four days, while the Madrid region is seeing its worst fires ever.

entries.title: Rand Paul releases Anthony Fauci's pandemic-era diary notes. Here's what they tell us
entries.snippet: Sen. Rand Paul has released a tranche of Dr. Anthony Fauci's diary entries from the COVID-19 pandemic. Fauci is set to appear before a Senate committee Wednesday on the origins of the coronavirus.

entries.title: Platner energized Maine's Democrats. Jackson's challenge will be to keep them engaged
entries.snippet: Democrats have a new candidate for U.S. Senate in Maine: Troy Jackson. In one of the country's most closely-watched races, he'll have less than 100 days to make his case.

entries.title: Authors have mixed feelings about the $1.5B Anthropic copyright infringement ruling
entries.snippet: Some say the $3,100 per title payout is small compensation for what they view as big, ongoing threats from the makers of generative AI models.

entries.title: Inside Joe Manchin's new quest to elect more Independents to Congress
entries.snippet: The former West Virginia senator was a lifelong Democrat before deciding to register as an independent two years ago. He now wants to create similar pathways for other politicians in both parties.

entries.title: The 'cockroach' in the machine: How Gen Z is rattling South Asia's elites
entries.snippet: South Asia's leaders have long boasted about their demographic dividend. But the region's young people are turning it into a political reckoning.

entries.title: 3 dead in mass shooting in Seattle. And, U.S. and Iran pause fighting
entries.snippet: A mass shooting at a Seattle festival has left three people dead. And, the U.S. and Iran have been exchanging diplomatic messages after nearly tw weeks of intense fighting.

entries.title: France continues to fight devastating wildfires, while progress is made in Spain
entries.snippet: In southern France, a wildfire in the region of Gironde is still active, while two major fires in central Spain are finally coming under control, ahead of the fourth heat wave of the summer.

entries.title: Kalshi attacks a Wisconsin law banning election bets as 'voter suppression'
entries.snippet: The spat between the leading prediction market company and a key battleground state could be a glimpse into the next major fight between states and the fast-growing industry.

entries.title: In Memphis, an 'anti-crime' task force quietly turned into an ICE crackdown
entries.snippet: The influx of federal agents into the city last fall led to widespread immigration arrests – a majority without criminal convictions. President Trump has said he wants to replicate it elsewhere.

entries.title: Baltimore will turn 911 into more than just an emergency number
entries.snippet: Baltimore is rethinking what it means to call 911, and who responds. Callers who don't need police will get help finding social services and healthcare before they actually fall into crisis.

entries.title: FIFA's Infantino lashes out at critics he says spread 'hate and false rumors' about World Cup
entries.snippet: FIFA and Infantino faced criticism during the World Cup for Iran team officials, a Somali referee and fans being denied entry to the United States; alleged political influence by U.S. President Donald Trump in letting Folarin Balogun avoid a ban for a red card; unprecedented high

entries.title: 'Tell us where to look for her.' Savannah Guthrie makes plea to her mother's kidnappers
entries.snippet: The video released Monday is the latest public plea from the journalist about 84-year-old Nancy Guthrie since her disappearance on Feb. 1 from her home just outside Tucson, Arizona. Savannah Guthrie said her family will never stop looking for her.

entries.title: 3 killed in shooting at crowded festival in Seattle
entries.snippet: Gunfire erupted at a food festival in Seattle, killing at least three people and wounding at least four others. One person is in custody, and police say another suspect may still be at large. Geoff Bennett reports on the city that is grieving and on edge.

entries.title: News Wrap: French firefighters battle massive wildfire
entries.snippet: In our news wrap Monday, firefighters in southwest France are battling a wildfire that's forced more than 200,000 people to flee, nearly 100 million Americans are under active heat alerts as climbing temperatures and severe humidity grip much of the country and traffic began flow

entries.title: U.S. air defense supply shrinks during Iran war, leaving experts concerned
entries.snippet: The exchange of fire between the United States and Iran has paused in the last few days. One challenge the U.S. has confronted in the war with Iran has been the shortfall in ballistic missile and drone defense systems. Nick Schifrin discussed more with Jerry McGinn. He was a seni

entries.title: Senate faces packed, complicated agenda as midterms loom
entries.snippet: On Capitol Hill, time is starting to run short for Congress as the midterm elections loom. The House is on summer recess, but the Senate is in Washington trying to handle a packed, complicated agenda. That includes a first vote on President Trump's pick as the Director of Nationa

entries.title: Gunmen attack a community in Nigeria and kill 30 people, residents say
entries.snippet: Gunmen attacked a community in northwestern Nigeria, killing at least 30 people and injuring several others, residents said Monday, in the latest violence in the conflict-hit region.

entries.title: India's youth-led 'cockroach' protests expose cracks in Modi's government
entries.snippet: What started as outrage over leaked medical entrance exams turned into one of India's largest youth-led protest movements challenging India's prime minister. They call themselves the cockroaches after a top official compared jobless youth to the pests. Producer Zeba Warsi reports

entries.title: Cyclospora and salmonella outbreaks raise concerns about U.S. food safety
entries.snippet: Public health concerns are widening as cyclosporiasis cases surge and a salmonella outbreak across 17 states has many Americans raising concerns about U.S. food safety. Back-to-back cases where people are getting sick from food have put many on edge. William Brangham discussed th

entries.title: Tamara Keith and Amy Walter on midterm voter enthusiasm
entries.snippet: NPR's Tamara Keith and Amy Walter of the Cook Political Report with Amy Walter join Geoff Bennett to discuss the latest political news, including both parties gearing up for a combative and expensive battle for control of Congress with fewer than 100 days to go until the midterms

entries.title: Documentary explores why U.S. mothers lack support systems found in other countries
entries.snippet: A new documentary explores the realities of motherhood in America, from the high cost of child care to the culture wars over parenting and raising a family. Amna Nawaz spoke with the filmmakers behind "No Country for Mothers" for our arts and culture series, CANVAS.

entries.title: French wildfire created country's 1st recorded pyrocumulonimbus cloud, igniting more fires
entries.snippet: A wildfire in southwest France grew so powerful that its smoke column became a thunderstorm, generating lightning that struck the ground and ignited new fires beyond the original blaze, French officials said.

entries.title: Wisconsin tornado causes extensive damage and cuts power to thousands of homes
entries.snippet: The National Weather Service confirmed a tornado in Winnebago County, about 90 miles northwest of Milwaukee.

entries.title: ICE extends no-bid contract for major detention center in Texas, rejecting calls for closure
entries.snippet: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement plans to keep one of its largest detention facilities open for at least another year. This decision comes despite reports of human rights abuses.

entries.title: 'Show me how this ends.' Thune responds to Trump's escalated calls to pass SAVE America Act
entries.snippet: Senate Majority Leader John Thune responded to President Donald Trump's escalating calls Monday to cancel the August recess until the Senate passes a proof-of-citizenship voting bill by again challenging the president.

entries.title: Trump administration urges Supreme Court to allow order targeting mail-in voting before midterms
entries.snippet: The Trump administration asked the Supreme Court on Monday to clear the way for an executive order from President Donald Trump that could dramatically change mail-in voting.

entries.title: Final texts from 14-year-old girl to singer D4vd shown in court at hearing on her killing
entries.snippet: Prosecutors detailed the last night of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez, showing her phone went silent after arriving at singer D4vd's home.

entries.title: Republicans decry a new Democratic Socialists of America platform as Dem primaries split the party
entries.snippet: A new platform from the progressive Democratic Socialists of America is sparking Republican attacks.

entries.title: Trump demands Senate cancel August break until it passes the SAVE America Act
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump is calling on Senate Majority Leader John Thune to keep senators in Washington until they pass a strict proof-of-citizenship voting bill.

entries.title: 76ers fans celebrate LeBron James' arrival in Philadelphia
entries.snippet: The 76ers and James announced Monday their two-year deal on the veteran's minimum for $8 million total was official and that the four-time NBA MVP was indeed a Sixer.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Chad's government says it's withdrawing from the ICC
entries.snippet: Chad's Foreign Ministry has announced plans to leave the International Criminal Court. It said that its effectiveness was "limited and uneven." Chad's leader is a military officer accused of repressing the opposition.

entries.title: German Chancellor Merz completes cabinet resuffle
entries.snippet: After days of confusion, Chancellor Friedrich Merz has reshuffled his cabinet. Conservative politicians fear that this will not help with the prospects in the upcoming state elections.

entries.title: Indian youth score a win over Modi with humor and grit
entries.snippet: Driven by social media satire, the Gen-Z-led "Cockroach" protest movement spurned by grievances over an exam scandal caused a shake-up in India's government. DW spoke with a few protesters in New Delhi.

entries.title: Ghana's community service bill: A fix for the prison crisis?
entries.snippet: The community service bill offers community service as an alternative to prison sentences, particularly for minor offenses. It's meant to decongest Ghana's prisons and prevent overcrowding once it's signed into law.

entries.title: Fujimori takes charge in Peru amid China, US balancing act
entries.snippet: Peru's new president, Keiko Fujimori, has promised more security and investment. As she takes office, she'll have to find space for the South American nation amid Washington and Beijing's geopolitical rivalry.

entries.title: How India's Gen-Z protesters shifted the political debate
entries.snippet: The resignation of India's education minister amounts to a stunning victory for the youth-led "Cockroach" protest movement. The bigger question is if this political momentum turns into a lasting platform for more reform.

entries.title: Germany: Islamist terror attack on Berlin Pride parade triggers political debate
entries.snippet: Following the terrorist attack on Berlin's Pride parade, the Christopher Street Day parade, politicians and security experts are demanding consequences.

entries.title: 'Amnesia' about measles risk and low vaccination rates have helped US infections grow
entries.snippet: The latest US data show measles cases from January to mid-July 2026 totaled more than all cases in 2025. Experts blame a fall in vaccination and warn that people have forgotten measles can be life-threatening.

entries.title: FIFA boss Infantino takes aim at World Cup critics
entries.snippet: In a strongly worded open statement, FIFA President Gianni Infantino has hit out at those he says were too "consumed by hate and criticism" to enjoy the tournament. Infantino brushed off a number of corruption concerns.

entries.title: Iran rules out US talks as Hormuz Strait remains closed
entries.snippet: Iran has not asked to resume talks with the US, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei said. He added that the Strait of Hormuz remains closed and that messages are being relayed through mediators. DW has more.

entries.title: Car ramming attacks: Why do they keep happening?
entries.snippet: Cars are being used as weapons, to ram, kill and maim innocent people. The reasons why are not always clear, nor are solutions to preventing such attacks.

entries.title: France: Macron holds crisis talks as wildfires spread
entries.snippet: As France and Spain battle some of their worst wildfires in years, the French government is holding a crisis meeting. A fire-generated storm cloud over France has added to fears of more outbreaks.

entries.title: The plague is as deadly today as in the Middle Ages
entries.snippet: Most people have only heard of the plague as the disease that ravaged Europe in the Middle Ages. But it's still around today, such as in Madagascar, and just as lethal as ever.

entries.title: Germany: Berlin Pride attack prompts calls for clampdown
entries.snippet: German conservatives are calling for a tougher course on suspected Islamists after the deadly Christopher Street Day attack in Berlin. The presumed attacker was released from detention this May. DW has the latest.

entries.title: India news: Greta Thunberg expresses solidarity with CJP protesters
entries.snippet: Greta Thunberg attended a celebratory rally organized by Indian students in London after major successes for the CJP movement. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: US: At least 3 killed in shooting in Seattle
entries.snippet: A shooting at a Seattle food festival left at least three people dead and four others wounded. The police took the suspect into custody.

entries.title: Congo Ebola death toll tops 1,400 as vaccine trials start
entries.snippet: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has continued to grow, with confirmed infections reaching 3,200 and a fatality rate of nearly one in two. Scientists are racing to test the first vaccines against the rare Bundibugyo strain.

entries.title: Brazil recalls ambassador to Argentina over Milei's remarks
entries.snippet: During a visit to Brazil to support far-right presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro, Argentina's president called the Brazilian leader a "convict" and a "thief."

entries.title: Berlin Pride ramming: Police shoot suspect dead
entries.snippet: Police said the suspect was shot dead in an operation, after the incident was classified as an "Islamist terrorist" attack. One person was killed and several others injured in the attack.
